cn.note: Approval applies to the marketed product, a mixture of two diastereomers.

toxicity.LD50_calculation_method: approximate, from clinical signs and deaths in groups of two
toxicity.Notes: Text: approximate LD50 after i.p. treatment 46 mg/kg (cisplatin 13 mg/kg, carboplatin 160 mg/kg); two male CD2F1 mice per dose, observed 28 days; doses tested not listed

pk.Dosing: 20 mg/m² (35 mg), single bolus within 1 min, phase I PK cycle 01
pk.PK_model: Three-compartment model (terminal γ t½, Vd = Vss)
pk.Notes: Source: in vivo/papers/10.1159_000217347.pdf | Table 2 p. 142, with dose in Table 1 p. 141. Study of 17 cycles in 15 patients with solid tumours. Each row represents one cycle and one fraction. Elemental platinum quantified by flameless atomic absorption. D-19466 is a diastereomeric mixture. Blood sampling through 48 h. Cmax and AUCdata divided by 1000 from µg/L and µg·h/L. AUCdata is the reported model-independent area, no extrapolated AUC field is assigned. The exact integration horizon is not identified per cycle. Distribution t½ 0.05 h. Intermediate t½ 0.68 h. Clearance per body surface area 82 mL/min/m². Urinary excretion through 48 h 20.6% of dose.
